name: composer-autopilot
description: Opt-in background Composer prediction sending for all or selected local Codex chats.

interface.shortDescription: Send predictions in chosen Codex chats without taking focus
interface.longDescription: A small local controller with all-active or selected-thread targeting, exclusions, and on/off controls. Requires macOS and a compatible Codex desktop renderer with loopback debugging enabled. Off by default.
defaultPrompt: Enable Composer Autopilot for selected chats
